title: Create from a candidate
summary: deployment-runs create and start-for-item bind the same source: without one, the gate branch tip, reusing that commit's own CI proof from any branch and dispatching only when it has none; an explicit commit needs its own proof. Recoveries name each command's own source flag and never suggest an older green commit that may omit a member. start-for-item first returns the run to the same environment already holding the item, or another project's in-flight release to it whose bound source contains its merge (reused); a live bound release without the merge refuses as bound_release_in_flight, naming the run and its pinned commit. Merge close-out at the release wait names the start-for-item command. Release-set creation sends any ordered list of flows in one deployment_runs.create (flows argument, serving floor next-release), binding one source commit from a flow that waits for CI first, so a tip with only merge-queue CI gets one dispatch, and assigning KEY:FLOW idempotency keys. Each flow owns its environment; an explicit environment or retry is refused with multiple flows. The set commits in one transaction: any refusal leaves no run and no takeover. A key whose run was cancelled before it started creates a fresh run; one cancelled after starting replays. The recipe can pin the full passing commit once with one checkout and source-ref, respecting declared QA gates. A correction needs a new release set on its passing commit; single-run tip binding and its ordinary key remain available.
